Description
50 Gram PAMP Suisse Rosa Gold Bar is manufactured by the world’s leading independent precious metal refiner, PAMP(Produits Artistiques Métaux Précieux) Suisse, and is a favorite among investors.
PAMP Suisse
was founded in 1977, in Ticino, Switzerland, and is renowned for its craftsmanship and design of high-quality precious metals all over the world. Pamp suisse 50g gold bars are a suitable choice for those looking to invest in high-quality swiss gold bars.
Each of these PAMP Suisse Gold Rosa Bars contains 50 grams (1.6075 troy oz) of .9999 fine gold and is individually wrapped in PAMPs sealed packets which includes an assay card.
The PAMP 50 gram gold bar is ideal for investors who appreciate the security and stability of owning
physical gold bullion
. This stunning  PAMP Suisse gold rosa bar is the symbol of prosperity and an excellent gift or investment opportunity.
Design of
50 Gram PAMP Suisse Rosa Gold Bar
50 Gram Rosa gold bar is a classic design by PAMP Suisse. The 50 gram rosa gold bar features a beautiful rosa design on the obverse side and weight, purity, and unique serial number on the reverse side. The rosa designs add beauty to this .9999 fine 50 gram gold rosa bar.
The PAMP logo is depicted at the top of the design space on the reverse of the 50 Gram PAMP Suisse roa gold bar, with the remaining markings arranged vertically along the bar’s face. The PAMP Logo features the letters PAMP encircled by a four-pointed star, with the word Suisse imprinted beneath. The 50 Gram PAMP Suisse rosa gold bar Gold Bar also includes the weight, purity, metal composition, and serial number on the reverse. The following are the serial numbers for this series: The serial numbers in this series are identified by a one-letter, six-number code.
